system.description:
Tidal bogs and reed marsh, where it is hard to tell land from water. Paths shift with the tide. The water is too murky to see into. People trust few strangers and learn which ground will hold.

Talent: one Finesse die to d6, one Wit die to d6.

  • Fen Curse. You learn the Fen Curse Technique: Ranged, -1 Oppose (1 minute).
  • Mire Cunning. +2 Training in Guile.
